pkgmove safety report: example.com/fx/hub -> example.com/fx/hub/sub
Files moved: 2. Findings: 9. Errors: 0.

Why this matters: a moved package is initialised before the package that
imports it, so init() functions and package-level var initialisers in the moved
files now run before every initialiser of the source package. Review each
ERROR/HIGH/WARN item below before merging.

== HIGH: init() in moved file ==
  hub/maint.go:56: init() now runs when package sub initialises, before every var initialiser and init() of hub

== HIGH: package-level var initialiser calls package code ==
  hub/maint.go:16: computed = ... calls seed

== WARN: exported method (may newly satisfy interfaces) ==
  hub/maint.go:25: widget.count -> Count: check dynamic interface assertions that could now match

== WARN: function alias declared as a var (a wrapper would change behaviour) ==
  hub/maint.go:61: guard calls recover() directly (a wrapper would make it return nil under defer), so it is aliased as a var instead of a wrapper; the var is assignable and initialised at package init
  hub/maint.go:74: whereVia calls where, which inspects its call stack (runtime.Caller; a wrapper adds a frame), so it is aliased as a var instead of a wrapper; the var is assignable and initialised at package init

  hub/core.go:53: MethodByName("Count") (widget.count -> Count); reflect sees exported methods only
